note: NPC lines and the opening chain's script. {rider} is the rider's name, {short} is how much money is missing. Speaker narrator has no name box.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Your first bike: a tired 50cc, bought with everything you had. You kick it over. Nothing.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Phoenix MX, the garage on the high street, fixes anything with an engine. Go and see the town's mechanic there.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Press Tab or tap Bike to check your bike, your bag and your current task.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: So you're the new rider everyone's on about? Paul Phoenix. This is my place. Let's have a listen to that 50.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Paul pulls the plug, squints at it, and shakes his head.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Top end's gone. Zero compression. That bike's going nowhere until it's replaced.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Here, take this used top end. It's off a customer's old bike and it's still got plenty of life in it.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I haven't got any tools.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: No, you'd need a proper workshop for that. Use my bench. It's £90 for bench time and the gaskets. Fit it and I'll pay you £120 for helping out after.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You got a used top end. The workbench is in the far corner of the garage.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Bench time is £90. You're {short} short.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You strip off the old cylinder head, clean the gasket faces and fit the new top end, step by step.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One kick. Two. The little 50 coughs, then settles into a crackly idle. It runs!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Hear that? Sounds like a bike again. Nice work. Here's the £120 I promised.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: If you're after more, I've got jobs. First, pop up the road to Moto78, Bill's bike shop, and collect my parts order.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The garage order? It's right here. Mind, it's heavier than it looks.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Once you're racing, come back and see me for parts. I stock Grades 1 to 3 for the 50s and 65s.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Lovely, that's everything. Here's £50 for the legwork.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Now, there are two customer bikes on the stands. Give them both a service: chain, filter and a once-over.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You adjust the chain, wash the air filter and check every bolt. That's one bike done.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Neat work. You've got the hands for this. That's £100.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Next, Lee at the tyres and wheels shop has a pair of tyres for me. Fetch them and fit them on my tyre machine.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: For the garage? Here you go, one pair of hard-pack tyres.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Hard pack round here, so you'll want a hard-pack rear on your own bike too, one day.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You break the beads, lever the old tyres off and seat the new ones. It's harder than it looks.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Not a pinch in sight. Here's £70.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: One more errand. This cylinder needs a rebore, and the engine rebuilder in the Industrial Zone does the best work. It's east along the main road.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: From the garage, is it? Give it here.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The lathe whines for a minute. The engine rebuilder hands the cylinder back, bright and true.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: There you go. If you ever want shifts, I've always got engine work. So does the fabrication shop next door.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Finish a whole batch for me and I'll let you keep one of the parts you made, as good as whatever you turned it to. Fair's fair.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Perfect bore. That's £80.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: You'll want to get to the tracks next, and for that you need a motor. Go and see Jedrick at Nicholls Used Motors, south of here.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Paul sent you? Then you'll want the old second-hand motor out back.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: It's high mileage, but it starts every time. It holds one bike, twenty parts and ten tools. Six hundred quid, no haggling.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I'll come back when I've got the money.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Six hundred for the motor? Fair price. Here's £40 extra for all your help today.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: If you're still short, the fabrication shop and the engine rebuilder always need shift workers.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Six hundred, and you're {short} short. Shifts in the Industrial Zone pay. Come back when you've got it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Pleasure doing business. Here are the keys. I've parked it outside your room.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Load your bike and your spares before you set off. A rider without spares is a spectator.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You wheel the bike up the ramp, strap it down, then load your spares and tools.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Everything has its place. Ready to go racing.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Got yourself a motor, I see. Then you're a proper racer now.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Try Farmland MX first. It's hard pack, flowing, and good for a first race. Take the west road out of town.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The council's just finished the roadworks on it, so you're in luck.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: There are two more down the same road: Riverside Arena by the river, and Longmoor Enduro out in the woods.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: See you on the gate.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Not now, I'm in the middle of something. Check your task.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: How's the 50 running? Bring it round if you need bench time.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Treat that motor right and it'll get you to every track in the area.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I still race when I can get away from the forecourt. See you on the gate, and don't expect me to move over.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Bill Rothon, Moto78. Parts for 50s and 65s, Grades 1 to 3. Have a look at the counter.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I race too, when the shop lets me. Everything on these shelves I've broken myself at some point, so I know what lasts.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Lee Stocky. Tyres, rims, spokes and brakes. Hard pack round here, so you'll want a hard-pack rear.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I was Area Champion a few seasons back, before the injury. I'm getting back on the bike this season, so you'll see me at the odd race.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Howzit. Jason Styles, J's Tools. Came over from South Africa chasing the dream, and I'm still chasing it: this is the season, I can feel it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Tool sets, one per part group. Buy a set once and it's yours for good. With the right set you repair and fit those parts yourself, at your tool cabinet at home or out of the back of your motor, and it costs you nothing but the grade.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Looking for shifts? Use the blue bench inside to start a batch of frame brackets. It's 75p a bracket.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Finish the batch and one of them's yours to keep. Stop whenever you like; it'll be waiting for you.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Want a shift? Start at the long bench inside. It's £1.25 a piston, and one part from every finished batch is yours to keep.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Do enough work for me and I might let you use the practice yard.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: You race? There are three local tracks round here, but you'll need a motor to reach them.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Farmland MX, west road. I'll see you on the gate.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Hello there! I'm Joseph Halden. My family runs every track in the land: Farmland MX, Riverside Arena, Longmoor Enduro, the lot.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: It started with Farmland. That track used to be our family's farm, and every bump out there has a story. The rest came along as the sport grew.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: You'll find me in the race office at every one of them. First time racing with us, {rider}? Your first race day is free. Sign on when you're ready, and have fun out there.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Good to see you, {rider}. Sign on here for race days and practice, same as at all our tracks.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: New face. Signing on for the 50s? I'm the current Area Champion, and I pretty much always win out there.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Don't worry, everyone gets lapped by me once.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Not bad out there. I'm still the Area Champion, mind. Keep coming back and you might give me a race one day.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: This old machine? Put a clean part in and see what comes out. Not today, though.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Hi {rider}! I coach the running club. Riders forget it, but a moto is hard work. The fitter you are, the less you fade at the end.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Fancy a session? Keep to the pace I set for each lap. Every session builds your Endurance.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Oh, hello! I'm always on this computer. Pop round any time.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Now you've got the bike running, here's some advice. Racing comes down to two things: you and your bike.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Ride, train and race to level up your skills. Every lap teaches you something.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Parts wear out as you ride. Keep an eye on them in your bike panel, and upgrade to better grades when you can afford it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I can repair a worn part here. It comes back one grade lower, but good as new. Grade 1 parts and broken parts can't be repaired, though. Those have to be replaced.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Oh, and there's a cocky lad by the practice track gate, Mickey Alington. He says nobody in town can beat him. Fancy proving him wrong?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Heard you've been helping out round town. Good on you.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Keep an eye out for Dan Smyth by the practice yard down the road. He's always causing trouble and telling everyone he's the fastest in the zone.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Look after your bike, and you might just beat him at his own game.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: And if you want shifts, use the blue bench inside to start a batch of frame brackets. It's 75p a bracket.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Hello there! Got a minute? This old part's seen better days, and I'm far too busy to take it in myself.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Could you get it repaired at the garage and bring it back? I'll pay you back what the repair costs, plus £5 for your trouble.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Any luck with my part? The garage on the high street can repair it. Remember, it's mine, so look after it!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Good as new! Thanks a lot. Here's the repair money back, plus a little extra.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Come and see me again. There's always something here that needs fixing.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: You? Race me? I might be stuck kicking my bike over now and then, but once she gets going, she's a rocket.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: They're building a brand new track here. Soon as it opens, I'll race you for £50 and show you what she can do.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Back for more? It's £50 to race me. Eight of us, three laps.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Win, and you get your £50 back plus £50 more. Anything but first, and I keep it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: You need £50 to race me. Come back when you've got it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: What? You beat me! Lucky day, that's all. Here's your money.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Rematch? Any time you like.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Told you I'm the fastest round here! Come back and try again whenever you like.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Your bike sounded a bit tired out there. Look after it and you'll give me a proper race.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Your bike's quick enough. It's your riding that needs a bit more practice.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Your bike's quick enough, but you looked worn out by the end. Get a bit fitter and you'll be right there.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Your bike's definitely quick enough. You were just unlucky today. Have another go!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Looking for trouble? I'd race you, but they're still building the new track in the yard.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Come back when it's done. Just you and me, £70, winner takes it all.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: So you want to race me? Just you and me, three laps, and it costs £70.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Beat me and you get your £70 back plus £70 more. Lose, and I keep it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: £70 or no race. Go and do some shifts, then come back.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: No way! Nobody beats me in the zone. Fine, here's your money.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I want a rematch. Same time, same place.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Ha! Too slow. The zone is mine. Come back when you think you're ready.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Manny Festo, at your service. I keep everyone up to date on what's coming next.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Area 2 is under construction right now. It's due to be ready in December 2026.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Come back and see me again to check for more updates.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Manny Festo! Told you I'd see you here. Welcome to Mountain Town: clay, rain and more rain.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Taylor Heart is the Area 2 Champion and Cal Mercer the Local Champion. Cal's the one you want: he opens the tracks round here.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The same faces run the shops: Paul, Bill, Lee and Jedrick all came up the valley with you. Paul's got something new on the racks.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: There you are! Mountain Town. Bigger bikes, wetter tracks and a champion who's never been beaten in the mud.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Go and see Paul at Phoenix MX first. He wants a word about what's new up here.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Good, you made it. Same garage, new town: repairs, the bench, the job board, and now a clothing rack by the door.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The rack's shut till you've got a wardrobe to hang things in. The Starter terrace by the road is for sale: buy it and the rack opens.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: While you're here: take this parts order up to Lee at the tyre shop. He's waiting on it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: That's my order! Cheers. Paul said you'd be along.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Wheels and tyres, same as ever, Grades 2 to 4 up here. And I'm racing again this season, so I'll see you at the gate.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: You'll be the rider Paul mentioned. This is the Wheel works: we lace and true wheels for half the valley.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Work a batch of 50 and you're paid a pound a wheel, Wheels XP every pass, and when the batch is done the best wheel of the lot is yours to keep.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Start at the blue bench when you're ready. Stop whenever you like: the batch waits for you.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The gym? Through here. Weights build Strength, and Strength is what keeps a 65 pointed straight through the clay.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: A round is forty seconds. Press on the beat, and every round counts whatever you lift. Come back whenever you want.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Cal Mercer. Local Champion. You'll have heard I know every line on the mountain.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The tracks are open to you now: Clayhill MX, Valley Arena and Bog End Enduro. Sign on with Joseph at any race office.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Win the Local Champion Championship here and the Area 2 badge is yours. Then it's Taylor Heart for the Area 2 title, and I'd bring a towel.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Phoenix MX, Mountain Town branch. Repairs, the bench, the job board, and the clothing rack once you've a wardrobe to use.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Jedrick Nicholls, still the man for motors. Up here I've got the Old Rusty Van: twice the room of the truck, with yours in part exchange.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Moto78! Bigger shelves up here: engine, suspension, bodywork and frames, Grades 2 to 4, for the 50s, 65s and the 85 small wheels.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Lee's T's & Wheels. Wheels, tyres and brakes to Grade 4. Mud tyres are the ones you want up here.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Wheel works. Fifty wheels a batch, a pound each, Wheels XP every pass, and the best wheel's yours when the batch is done. Blue bench to start.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Cal Mercer, Local Champion. Nobody beats me in the mud. Enter the Local Champion Championship at any race office if you fancy trying.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The badge is yours, fair and square. Taylor Heart's next: the Area 2 Championship, six rounds. Go on then.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Taylor Heart. Area 2 Champion, three years running. The Area 2 Championship is six rounds, two at every track, and I win most of them.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: You beat me. Properly. The road east is open and Beach Town's waiting. Don't forget where you learned to ride in the wet.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Town gym. Weights for Strength. Forty seconds a round, press on the beat, and every round counts.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The practice yard's yours: body position, cone braking and rut riding. Pick a drill at the yard. Every round counts.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Kyle Brooks. I've a race for you, but my forks are shot and I'm skint. Get them repaired for me and I'll race you for £80 on my own track.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Forks sorted? Then let's race. £80 says you can't live with me on the mountain loop.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Come back with £80. I don't race for nothing.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: You had me there. Take it: you earned it. Rematch any time.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Told you. Easy money. Come back when you've done some laps.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Freya Collins. Want a race? My brakes are gone and the garage won't look at them till they're paid for. Sort them and I'll race you for £80.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Brakes done? Right. £80, my track, no excuses.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: £80 or no race.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Ugh. Fine. Yours. I'll have it back next time.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Thanks for the £80. The rut by the pond gets everyone.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: My forks. Dead. Take them down to Phoenix MX, get them repaired and bring them back. I'll pay the repair back plus £10, and then we race.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Forks back yet? Phoenix MX, on the high street.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: That's them! Here's the repair money and a tenner. Now we race, whenever you're ready.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Brakes. Get them repaired at Phoenix MX and bring them back. Repair money plus £10 for you, then we race.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: No brakes, no race. Phoenix MX will sort them.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Perfect. Repair money and a tenner. Now, about that race.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: You're not skilled enough for me to waste my time on. Go and practise, and come back when you're on a 450cc.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Manny Festo, still one town ahead of you. Welcome to Beach Town: dunes, sand and sea wind.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Aidan Gizard is the Area 3 Champion and Jonah Pike the Local Champion. Jonah Pike opens the tracks round here, so find them first.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Paul, Bill, Lee and Jedrick have all set up again. The Brake works is hiring and the beach agility ladder is open.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: You made it! Beach Town: dunes, sand and sea wind. The 85cc small wheel class races here, and the shops stock Grades 3 to 5.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Go and see Paul at Phoenix MX first. He's got the lie of the land.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Good to see you. Same garage, new town: repairs, the bench and the job board, Grades 3 to 5 now.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The Semi with garage by the road is for sale if you want a bed here. While you're in: take this parts order over to Lee, he's waiting on it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: That's my order! Cheers. Paul said you'd be along.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Wheels, tyres and brakes to Grade 5 here. I'm racing the 85cc small wheels this season, so I'll see you at the gate.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: You'll be the rider Paul mentioned. This is the Brake works: brake calipers, 50 a batch at £1 each.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Work a batch and the best brakes of the lot is yours when it's done, with XP every pass. Start at the blue bench. Stop whenever you like: the batch waits.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Big Pete. I trained every one of the champions you're about to race, and I'll train you.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Jump timing and whoops on my sand track, forty seconds a round, every round counts. And listen: from Rider Ability 30 you can throw a whip over the big jumps, and from 60 a scrub. Shown you how. Now go and use it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Jonah Pike. Local Champion. You'll have heard about me.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The tracks are open to you now: Dune Park MX, Pier Arena and Shoreline Enduro. Sign on with Joseph at any race office.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Win the Local Champion Championship here and the Area 3 badge is yours. Then it's Aidan Gizard for the Area 3 title.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Phoenix MX, Beach Town branch. Repairs, the bench and the job board, Grades 3 to 5.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Jedrick Nicholls, still the man for motors. Here I've got the MX Van Short: more room again, with yours in part exchange.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Moto78! Engine, suspension and bodywork, Grades 3 to 5, up to the 85cc small wheels and beyond.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Lee's T's & Wheels. Wheels, tyres and brakes to Grade 5. The right rubber for dunes.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Brake works. 50 a batch, £1 a part, XP every pass, and the best of the batch is yours when it's done. Blue bench to start.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Jonah Pike, Local Champion. Enter the Local Champion Championship at any race office if you fancy your chances.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The badge is yours, fair and square. Aidan Gizard's next: the Area 3 Championship, six rounds. Go on then.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Aidan Gizard. Area 3 Champion. The Area 3 Championship is six rounds and I win most of them.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: You beat me. Properly. The road to Forest Town is open. Go and collect your 85cc big wheel.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Beach agility ladder. Agility ladder for Agility. Forty seconds a round and every round counts.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Big Pete's sand track: jump timing, whoops and sand. Pick a drill at the yard. Every round counts.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Owen Price. I've a race for you, but my top end is shot and I'm skint. Get it repaired for me and I'll race you for £120 on my own track.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Top end sorted? Then let's race. £120 says you can't live with me round s dune loop.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Come back with £120. I don't race for nothing.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: You had me there. Take it: you earned it. Rematch any time.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Told you. Easy money. Come back when you've done some laps.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: My top end. Dead. Take it to Phoenix MX, get it repaired and bring it back. I'll pay the repair back plus £10, and then we race.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Top end back yet? Phoenix MX, on the high street.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: That's it! Here's the repair money and a tenner. Now we race, whenever you're ready.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Callum Reid. I've a race for you, but my forks are shot and I'm skint. Get them repaired for me and I'll race you for £120 on my own track.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Forks sorted? Then let's race. £120 says you can't live with me round s beach strip.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Come back with £120. I don't race for nothing.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Ugh. Fine. Yours. I'll have it back next time.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Thanks for the £120. Same again whenever you like.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: My forks. Dead. Take them to Phoenix MX, get them repaired and bring them back. I'll pay the repair back plus £10, and then we race.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Forks back yet? Phoenix MX, on the high street.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: That's it! Here's the repair money and a tenner. Now we race, whenever you're ready.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Manny Festo, still one town ahead of you. Welcome to Forest Town: roots, loam and wet woods.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Kate Gizard is the Area 4 Champion and Rowan Ash the Local Champion. Rowan Ash opens the tracks round here, so find them first.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Paul, Bill, Lee and Jedrick have all set up again. The Suspension shop is hiring and the woodland yoga retreat is open.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: You made it! Forest Town: roots, loam and wet woods. The 85cc big wheel class races here, and the shops stock Grades 4 to 6.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Go and see Paul at Phoenix MX first. He's got the lie of the land.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Good to see you. Same garage, new town: repairs, the bench and the job board, Grades 4 to 6 now.

lines.speaker: npc

lines.text: Top end back yet? Phoenix MX, on the high street.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: That's it! Here's the repair money and a tenner. Now we race, whenever you're ready.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Maggie. The machine's running, thanks to you. The rules, since you'll forget: a clean part, 80% or better, nothing on it already.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Three modifiers come out, each as likely bad as good, and one part in ten doesn't come out at all. No rerolls. £20 a go at Grade 1 and it doubles every grade.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Here's one for you. Mad Maggie, the scientist with the machine in the Industrial Zone back home? Brilliant woman, bit eccentric, if you know what I mean. That machine's been dead for years.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The Frame works boss here used to work with her. Go and ask. I reckon she'd have it running again with the right hands.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Maggie the scientist? I welded half that machine. It needs two things she could never get: a wound coil, and the Suspension shop in Forest Town makes them now, and a precision valve from the Brake works in Beach Town.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Fetch those and she'll talk you through the fix. Mind, it's a Mechanical Engineer 30 job. Below that you'll make it worse.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: A coil for Maggie's machine? I wondered when someone would come for one. Here, wound this morning. Tell her the Suspension shop says hello.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: A valve for Maggie? Ha. She's the reason I'm in brakes: she taught me precision. Take this one, it's the best I've made. And good luck with her: she's a one-off.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Going to see Maggie the scientist, are you? Take these two old parts for her first test. She'll want something to put through it before she trusts it, and I'd not risk your own.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Mad Maggie, and yes, that's what they call me. You've brought the coil and the valve? And you know what you're doing? Then in you go: the coil behind the dial, the valve under the hopper.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: There. Hear that hum? Years, I've waited for that. Now, the test. Two old parts in, two out, if it works.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Part one in... and, whoops. Gone. Forgot to tell you about that: one go in ten, it eats the part. No rerolls, no refunds, and parts must be clean, 80% or better, with nothing on them already.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Part two in... and out it comes, with Corners up one, Rough down one, Wet down one. Better luck next time, but at least it didn't disappear. It's yours. The machine's open: £20 a go at Grade 1, doubling every grade.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: You've got the bits, but not the hands yet. Mechanical Engineer 30 before you touch my machine. Below that you'll make it worse.
